s.zh: 20 级的冒险者经验照常累积；成为传奇冒险者（20 级 + DND 里程碑）后可以继续升到 40 级，攒下的经验立即结算。21～40 级不给属性提升和专长，每级 2 个传奇属性点（八项，无上限）；VPE 路径点每 2 级 1 点。\n传奇属性点不乘“属性效果强度”，Isekai 共存模式下照样生效。关闭后不再升传奇等级，传奇属性点暂时没有效果（点数保留）。
s.en: Adventurer XP at level 20 keeps accumulating as usual; after becoming a legendary adventurer (level 20 + DND milestone), you can keep leveling to 40, and accumulated XP is settled immediately. Levels 21-40 give no ability score improvements or feats, but 2 legend attribute points per level (eight attributes, uncapped); VPE path points 1 per 2 levels.\nLegend attribute points aren't multiplied by "ability effect strength" and still apply in Isekai coexistence mode. When off, no more legend levels are gained and legend attribute points have no effect for now (points are kept).

s.zh: 殖民者自动投传奇属性点
开启后殖民者的传奇属性点自动投：近战职业 近战 + 血量，施法职业 心灵 + 血量，其他人 工作 + 学习（需要 VPE 的 DND 职业来区分）。关闭时在“冒险者”分页手动投。敌人永远自动。
s.en: When on, colonists' legend attribute points are spent automatically: martial classes melee + health, spellcasting classes psychic + health, everyone else work + learning (needs VPE DND classes to tell apart). When off, spend them manually on the "Adventurer" tab. Enemies are always automatic.

s.zh: 剧情首领、宿敌冠军和袭击领队可以到 21～40 级（自动成为传奇、自动投点）：领队的每人点数超出 20 级门槛的部分每 60 点 +1 级；剧情首领按当前威胁点数的 20% 算；宿敌冠军 = 殖民地最高等级 + 2。需要同时打开“敌人冒险者等级”。\n开不开 Isekai 共存模式都用这一个开关（1.63.0 起不再分两份）。
s.en: Story bosses, nemesis champions and raid leaders can reach levels 21-40 (automatically becoming legendary and spending points): leaders get +1 level per 60 points of their share above the level 20 threshold; story bosses count 20% of current threat points; nemesis champions = colony's highest level + 2. Needs "enemy adventurer levels" on too.\nThis one switch is used with or without Isekai coexistence mode (no longer split in two since 1.63.0).
